findings_qualitative.value: Filamentary PAH emission extends off the stellar disk in both galaxies, bright in F770W and F2100W, absent in NIRCam bands; ionized gas outflows adjacent but not overlapping.

evidence.quote: These ionized gas outflows seem to be adjacent to, but not overlapping with, the cool outflows detected in the F770W band.

claims.hypothesis: The two galaxies host cool outflows detectable in PAH emission
claims.experiment: F770W_SS/F300M ratio maps compared with 18 high-inclination galaxies
claims.result: Only these two show ratios above twice the central value off-plane and rising ratio with height
claims.finding: Extended PAH structures are candidate cool outflows, not tidal stripping

evidence.quote: Only the two outflow candidate host galaxies show F770W$_{\rm{SS}}$/F300M reaching above twice the central ratio

claims.hypothesis: Outflows have mass loading near unity
claims.experiment: MIR-derived gas mass with assumed velocity and extent
claims.finding: Consistent with mass loading ~unity but order of magnitude uncertain

evidence.loc: 4.2 Estimating Mass Outflow Rates in the MIR
evidence.quote: These mass outflow rates are close to what would be expected for a mass loading factor ($\dot{M}$/SFR) of $\sim$unity

why_this_method.value: MIRI is more sensitive than ALMA CO for the faint outflow edges, so predicted I_CO from F770W is used

evidence.loc: 4.2 Estimating Mass Outflow Rates in the MIR
evidence.quote: to leverage the higher sensitivity of the MIRI observations

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: F150W rejected for continuum removal due to striping; F300M used instead

evidence.quote: We use the F300M images to remove continuum instead of F150W due to persistent striping in F150W

limitations_admitted.value: No velocity information from photometry so outflows cannot be confirmed; velocities highly uncertain; alpha_CO uncertainty up to factor of four

evidence.quote: we cannot definitively confirm whether these structures are truly outflows

evidence.loc: 4.2 Estimating Mass Outflow Rates in the MIR
